note: StepFun's September 23, 2026 flagship — the first Step-4 release and a return to open-weights flagships after the May Step-3.7-Flash mid-tier (610B/38B MoE, Apache-2.0). The launch table is StepFun's broadest yet: every shared row lands 4-8 points over 3.7-Flash, with a first-time OSWorld 3.0 filing (71.4) alongside ByteDance on the new revision. Capability flags keep the Step convention — agentic stays false (no first-party agent harness), and the $0.40/$1.60 API price undercuts the open-weights cohort.
